skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Cardwinner
skins.content: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Cardwinner. Tequila's formal stage outfit. Qualified hosts heat up the audience; excellent hosts strive to eliminate any errant possibility.
skins.quote: In Tequila's hands, every card is a trump card, and in that respect, he's a resident professional.

skins.name: Top Tier Live
skins.content: Monster Siren Records Idol Project 'Shining Steps' Promotional Costume/Top Tier Live. Always with a shining smile, a gentlemanly attitude, and impressive skills. Only just on stage, and Tequila's already mesmerized the crowd.
skins.quote: Though it was his first audition, Tequila's score shot far past the competition. The other idol wannabes wanted to ask how to be as charming as him, but within minutes found themselves won over by his smile and joining his fan club.
